metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 직선과 경계 ② 물체의 범위와 회전 뒤 경계
metadata.description:
연결선을 만들었지만 선이 닿을 대상의 크기는 아직 모릅니다. 둥근 물체를 구로, 길쭉하고 복잡한 물체를 상자로 감싸는 이유부터 살펴보고, 겹치는 범위를 한 축씩 계산합니다. 이어서 물체가 회전하면 왜 경계를 다시 구해야 하는지 확인하고, 중심과 반크기를 이용해 계산을 이어갑니다. 실제 몸의 접촉과 단순한 경계의 겹침도 구분합니다. 직선과 경계 두 편 중 두 번째 강의입니다.

얌얌코딩 홈페이지
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · Lines and Bounds 2: Object Extents and Bounds after Rotation
englishMetadata.description:
We have built a connection, but we still need the size of its target. We explain why round objects can be enclosed by spheres and more complex objects by boxes, then calculate overlapping intervals one axis at a time. Next, we see why rotation requires new bounds and continue the calculation using the center and half-size. We also distinguish actual body contact from overlapping bounds. This is the second lecture on lines and bounds.

Game Math PART2 course materials
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and 60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Overview: the target’s extent and rotated bounds
00:22 Visible roundness and collision bounds
01:10 Compare a round head with an elongated body
01:28 Inside a sphere means close enough to its center
01:56 Separate the surface from the interior
02:43 Does twice the radius mean twice the size?
03:26 Enclosing an elongated body with a round bound
03:45 Enclose a complex shape simply
04:33 Data for an axis-aligned box
05:20 Choose minima and maxima one axis at a time
05:46 Build a box from five points
06:36 Overlap starts with intervals on one axis
07:12 The outline and enclosure of a moved cube
07:53 Overlapping bounds do not prove body contact
08:47 Candidate checks and precise checks
09:34 After overlap, update the rotated values
09:52 Rotating only two corners gives wrong bounds
10:38 Separate body rotation from screen changes
11:16 Camera changes and the reference axes
12:19 Why use absolute values for half-size?
12:58 Transform the center and half-size
13:49 Empty space inside an enclosing range
14:22 Decide what the bound encloses
15:18 Connect two worked problems
16:13 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.

YamYamCoding is a Korean game-programming channel covering DirectX, Unity, Unreal Engine and computer graphics.
